floor_probe.conclusion: 400,000 is unreachable even by overriding every protection. The floor is a property of the irreducible mass, not of the refusals.

irreducible_remainder_above_400k.note: None of this was inside the refused inventory. The mass above 400,000 was never in the protected set.

floor_probe.method: In a scratch worktree, delete every item any lane refused, then run every gate without repairing anything. Nothing merged.
floor_probe.purpose: Supply the precise failing capability or operational gate the campaign's floor rule requires, which named refusals alone do not provide.
floor_probe.silent_losses: automation, seed-c, the orphan schema crates and bitslice_vec die with little or no rustc signal because they had no reverse dependencies -- their loss is capability loss without a compiler gate, which is why lanes refused them on judgment rather than on a failing build.

why_300k_is_not_reachable: Rust is 245,682 of the 437,199 tree and measured at roughly 1% reclaimable across two independent adversarial attempts. HIDE is 115,089 and returned 8% of target with the remainder named as live product. Reaching 300,000 would require eliminating 137,199 more lines from subsystems that have each been attacked and have each returned their reasons. The only remaining lever is relocation -- moving HIDE to a sibling repository -- which this campaign explicitly gives zero credit.
